description: 兵腾挪d5，清开d5让马跳入叉击
explanation_en: The pawn advances to clear d5 for the knight. After the bishop captures the pawn, Nd5 forks Black's queen and knight.

intro.popup: 💡 腾挪：白兵在d5，挡住了白马Nc3/Nb3跳入d5的路线。如何腾空d5让马发动叉击？
intro.popup_en: 💡 Clearance: White's pawn on d5 blocks a knight from landing there. How can White clear d5 so the knight can create a fork?

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：d6！兵腾挪，强迫Bxd6——Nd5马叉Qb6和Re7/Nb6，赢得子力！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: d6 clears d5 and forces Bxd6. Nd5 then forks Black's queen on b6 and knight, winning material.

moves.popup: 白兵d6！从d5推进d6，腾空d5格，强迫黑象应对！
moves.popup_en: White advances the pawn from d5 to d6, clearing d5 and forcing Black's bishop to respond.

moves.popup: 黑象Bxd6——被迫吃兵，d5完全腾空！
moves.popup_en: Black's bishop captures the pawn on d6, leaving d5 completely clear.

moves.popup: 白马Nd5！跳入腾空的d5，同时攻击Qb6和Nb6——捉双！
moves.popup_en: White's knight jumps to the cleared d5 square and attacks the queen on b6 and knight on b6 at once: a fork!

moves.popup: 白马Nxb6+！叉击得子，腾挪战术收益！
moves.popup_en: White captures on b6 with check, winning material as the payoff for the clearance and fork.
